# Each case is a name, a tab, and a command line; the | marks the cursor, which is always at the
# end (a trailing space would not survive an editor). A third field, unordered, marks a case
# whose candidates a shell reads from a directory, in the file system's order; the test sorts
# them. Every shell's driver completes every case, and want/<shell>.txt holds what each one
# offered.
commands	app |
command-prefix	app re|
flags	app -|
flag-set-left-out	app --format json --|
negated	app --no-|
enum-declared-order	app --level |
enum	app --format |
enum-inline	app --format=|
file-extensions	app --config |	unordered
directory	app --dir |	unordered
none-with-message	app --token |
executable	app --exec rotini-|
user	app --user rotini|
group	app --group rotini|
host	app --host rotini-|
map-keys	app --set |
help-command	app help |
help-command-deep	app help remote |
completer	app deploy |
required-first	app deploy -|
group-left-out	app deploy --quiet -|
sub-command-enum	app deploy --env |
